ValidationRule.description: Checks whether a contact role is complete for Opportunities with probability >50
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c), Probability >= 0.50, Has_Complete_Contact_Role__c = FALSE, ISBLANK(SBQQ__AmendedContract__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'ALM - Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'B2BMA Integration User', ( NOT(TEXT(StageName) = "Cancellation - Pending Review") && NOT(TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Lost") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Please make sure the Contact Role is flagged in the Contract Role as the Primary Contact and has an Email, Job Title, First Name and Billing Address.
The associated Account must have Billing Country, City and Street populated.
